environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in EKS behind an NGINX Ingress Controller configured with mutual TLS verification. The ingress resource specifies annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client: 'on' with auth-tls-secret pointing to a CA bundle (namespace/client-ca-cert) containing only the internal PKI root CA. The auth-tls-verify-depth is set to 2 and auth-tls-pass-certificate-to-upstream-header is enabled. Additionally, the ingress has annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-error-page pointing to a 403 static page. The internal PKI issues client certificates only to registered service accounts via Vault PKI secrets engine with max_ttl=1h and allowed_domains restricted to *.internal.corp. External clients without a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA receive TCP RST at the TLS handshake layer before any HTTP payload reaches the Flask application. The NetworkPolicy on the pod restricts ingress to only the ingress controller pods on port 8080.
